**Aroha Astrology – Free Kundli, Rashifal, Panchang & Vedic Astrology**

Explore your future with **Free Kundli, Daily Rashifal, Panchang and Vedic astrology predictions — all in one app.** Generate your complete Janam Kundali with **Lagna, Rashi, Nakshatra, Vimshottari Dasha, Yogas, planetary positions and detailed astrological insights.** Check Kundli Milan, Guna Milan, Manglik analysis and compatibility reports. Available in **7 languages**.

Whether you seek clarity about your **career, love, relationships, marriage, finance, education or personal growth**, Aroha Astrology combines traditional Vedic astrology with modern AI-powered technology to provide personalized insights based on your birth chart.

### ✨ Key Features

**🔮 AI-Powered Vedic Insights**
Get personalized readings and life insights powered by AI, with detailed analysis of your Lagna, Rashi, Nakshatra, planets and houses.

**📜 Complete Janam Kundali**
Explore your birth chart with Lagna, Rashi, Nakshatra, planetary positions, houses, Vimshottari Dasha, Yogas and Doshas.

**⏳ Dasha & Yoga Analysis**
Understand the traditional astrological timing of life events through Vimshottari Dasha and discover important Yogas in your chart.

**🌞 Daily Rashifal & Horoscopes**
Get Daily, Weekly, Monthly and Yearly Rashifal along with personalized horoscope insights.

**🪔 Daily Panchang & Transit Updates**
Access Panchang details, planetary transits and important astrological information to stay aligned with the traditional Vedic calendar.

**💑 Kundli Milan & Matchmaking**
Check marriage compatibility with Guna Milan, Manglik analysis, Dosha reports and detailed partner compatibility insights.

**💎 Vedic Remedies**
Explore traditional remedies including personalized gemstone recommendations, mantras and other astrological practices.

**🕉️ Mantra Jaap Counter**
Track your daily mantra chanting with a built-in Jaap counter and explore mantras traditionally associated with your birth chart.

**📊 Detailed Astrology Reports**
Get personalized reports covering Career, Love, Marriage, Finance, Health, Education, Business and Personal Growth.

**🌍 7 Languages**
Available in **English, Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Telugu, Tamil and Gujarati.**

### 🔴 Chat & Call with Astrologers

Connect with experienced astrologers through **instant chat, calls and live sessions**. Get your **first chat/call session FREE** with participating astrologers.
